title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXXV OF 2017
ACT XXXV OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HOUSING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2017
An Act further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Housing Authority Act, 2005
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary, 10th
November, 2017]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills / 2017 / 12239, dated 10.11.2017.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority
(Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 27th October, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 7th November, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Act,
2005 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XI of 2005), for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follow:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority (Amendment) Act,
2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
